title: Pensioners to stage dharna in Delhi today

ai.summary: Pensioners plan a dharna in Delhi demanding restoration of old pension rules, pension revisions, and other benefits after government inaction on their representations.

facts.claim: Thousands of pensioners will stage a dharna at Eastern Court, New Delhi, on Wednesday
facts.quote: Thousands of pensioners will stage a dharna at Eastern Court, New Delhi, on Wednesday

facts.claim: The organisation said its memorandum, Call Attention Day and three-day State-level dharna had yielded no response
facts.quote: The organisation said its memorandum, Call Attention Day and three-day State-level dharna had yielded no response

facts.claim: It is demanding restoration of old pension rules and the Old Pension Scheme, pension revision, merger of 50 per cent DA/DR with pay and pension, and pension parity
facts.quote: It is demanding restoration of old pension rules and the Old Pension Scheme, pension revision, merger of 50 per cent DA/DR with pay and pension, and pension parity

facts.claim: Other demands include restoration of commutation after 10 years and eight months, and improved CGHS coverage and treatment facilities for pensioners
facts.quote: Other demands include restoration of commutation after 10 years and eight months, and improved CGHS coverage and treatment facilities for pensioners

ai.background_note: Pensioners are demanding restoration of old pension rules and the Old Pension Scheme, pension revisions, and other benefits after government inaction on their representations.
